scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix web-csr && npm install --prefix web-ssr
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web-csr,web-ssr -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix web-csr" "npm run dev --prefix web-ssr"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix web-csr && npm run build --prefix web-ssr
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,web-csr,web-ssr -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix web-csr" "npm run start --prefix web-ssr"
